description: REVIEW-02 / A-29: which pull requests the approver identity may approve. Paths decide a change's class; the most restrictive class a change touches wins, and a path no class names falls in the unmatched class. The approver approves only when every required check passed on the exact head commit, the branch is up to date, and no class touched forbids it. Humans own this file; agents never edit it.

classes.why: The specification, the guard, agent instructions, the approval machinery and agent identity. A human code owner reviews and freezes.
What the pipeline can do and what code it pulls in. Dependency changes wait for DEPS-01.
Built against frozen specifications; the required checks are the review.
Unprotected documents; the docs pass and the docs checks apply.
